entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Oct 01, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Integration

Projects / AI Gateway

  • agentgateway (⭐5.1k) (⭐5k) - An open-source data plane for agentic AI connectivity, providing security, observability, and governance for agent-to-tool (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
  • Bifrost (⭐8.4k) (⭐8.5k) - A high-performance AI gateway written in Go that unifies more than 20 model providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, and governance.

Projects / API Design

  • OpenAPI Style Validator (⭐237) (⭐236) - Ensure that your OpenAPI specs meet your organization's standards with this flexible and customizable style validator.
  • Zally (⭐947) (⭐946) - Ensure the quality of your OpenAPI specs with this linter tool that provides extensive analysis and feedback.

Projects / API Documentation

  • RapiDoc (⭐1.9k) (⭐1.9k) - Produces highly customizable, interactive API documentation with responsive design and rich configuration options.
  • Zudoku (⭐598) (⭐596) - A customizable framework built on OpenAPI, focused on delivering exceptional developer experiences through quality documentation.

Projects / API Gateway

  • Traefik API Gateway (⭐65k) (⭐65k) - Combines Traefik Proxy, a fully declarative application proxy with enterprise-grade access control, distributed security, and premium integrations.

Projects / API Management

  • Gravitee.io API Management (⭐458) (⭐456) - A lightweight, open-source platform offering flexible API governance, robust security, and straightforward configuration.

Projects / B2B Integration

  • phase4 (⭐239) (⭐239) - Embeddable, lightweight Java library implementing the AS4 messaging protocol, including the Peppol and CEF/eDelivery profiles.
  • Smooks (⭐421) (⭐421) - Extensible Java framework for processing and transforming structured data such as EDI, XML, CSV, and JSON.

Projects / Business Rules Engine

  • OpenL Tablets (⭐207) (⭐207) - Flexible open-source decision management system that simplifies defining and executing business rules and decision tables.

Projects / Data Integration

  • dlt (⭐5.9k) (⭐5.9k) - Open-source Python library for building data pipelines as code, with schema evolution and incremental loading out of the box.
  • Estuary Flow (⭐981) (⭐979) - Versatile, scalable platform that provides both real-time and batch data integration for ETL and ELT pipelines.
  • Pentaho Data Integration (⭐8.4k) (⭐8.4k) - Intuitive, visual ETL tool that simplifies data ingestion, blending, and cleansing across multiple sources without heavy coding.
  • Sling (⭐911) (⭐909) - Fast ELT command-line tool and Go library for moving data between databases, files, and cloud storage across a wide set of connectors.

Projects / Data Mapping Solution

  • Kaoto (⭐128) (⭐128) - Visual data mapper for Apache Camel with a drag-and-drop interface supporting XML, JSON, CSV, and XSLT transformations. Successor to AtlasMap.

Projects / Enterprise Service Bus

  • WSO2 Integrator: MI (⭐265) (⭐264) - The configuration-driven integration runtime of the WSO2 Integrator platform, supporting enterprise integration patterns in centralised and containerised deployments.

Projects / Schema Registry

  • Apicurio Registry (⭐940) (⭐939) - Open-source registry for API designs and schemas, supporting Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and AsyncAPI artifacts with configurable compatibility rules.
  • Karapace (⭐637) (⭐637) - Open-source, drop-in replacement for Confluent Schema Registry and the Kafka REST API.

Projects / Self-Service Integration

  • Huginn (⭐50k) (⭐50k) - Self-hosted system for building agents that monitor services and act on your behalf, like a hackable version of IFTTT.
  • n8n (⭐206k) (⭐206k) - Open-source workflow automation tool with 400+ connectors, giving you full control over your data and integrations.

Projects / Workflow Engine

  • Apache Airflow (⭐47k) (⭐47k) - Platform for programmatically creating, scheduling, and monitoring workflows, ideal for managing complex data pipelines.
  • Argo Workflows (⭐17k) (⭐17k) - Container-native workflow engine designed for orchestrating parallel jobs in Kubernetes-based, cloud-native environments.
  • Camunda (⭐4.3k) (⭐4.3k) - Process orchestration platform built on the horizontally scalable Zeebe engine, with full BPMN and DMN support.
  • Inngest (⭐5.9k) (⭐5.9k) - Event-driven durable execution platform that runs reliable step functions inside your existing services.
  • LittleHorse (⭐401) (⭐401) - High-throughput, low-latency microservice orchestration engine built on Kafka Streams, with SDKs in multiple languages.
  • Windmill (⭐18k) (⭐18k) - Open-source developer platform that turns scripts in Python, TypeScript, Go, and more into workflows, internal UIs, and scheduled jobs.

Resources / API Specification

  • Arazzo Specification (⭐475) (⭐473) - A standard, programming language-agnostic representation for describing sequences of API calls (workflows) and their dependencies.

Resources / Data Formats

  • YAML (⭐505) (⭐505) - A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.

2. Alternative Internet

Hosting and media

  • Serveronet is a P2P Network of Websites. You can deploy decentralized websites which behave like classic Internet Sites. It's Free and Open source. You can use it on your own PC as a client or deploy on a public hosting server. Serveronet is a Cryptographic Peer 2 Peer Network of Sites.

3. Awesome Selfhosted

Software / Communication - Custom Communication Systems

  • OpenWA ⚠ - WhatsApp API gateway exposing messaging as REST endpoints, with a web dashboard, multi-account sessions, and webhook events (alternative to WhatsApp Business API providers). (Source Code (⭐15k), Clients (⭐58)) MIT Docker

4. Awesome Privacy

PC / MacOS

  • MS Windows - Owned by Microsoft it is known for collecting many user data and tricking users to own a Microsoft account. If you still want and happen to use Windows 10 or 11, you can use Win11Debloat (⭐58k), or this other tool to see and disable the tons of privacy-invasive settings of MS Windows.

Decentralized

  • Nostr - Open protocol that is able to create a censorship-resistant global "social" network. It doesn't rely on any trusted central server, hence it is resilient; it is based on cryptographic keys and signatures, so it is tamperproof; it does not rely on P2P techniques, therefore it works. Note: Nostr is a protocol, so it is capable of offering much more than a Twitter alternative.

5. Awesome Developer First

Monitoring

  • Phare - Uptime monitoring, incident management and status pages. REST API, first-party Terraform support, and plenty of integrations.

6. Awesome Newsletters

Swift / Svelte

  • The iOS Weekly Brief. A weekly, hand-curated filter of the best iOS and Swift links for experienced engineers, each with the author's own comment on why it matters.

Open Source / Svelte

  • Nossletter. A free daily newsletter breaking down the best merged PRs in open source.

Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning / Big Data / Svelte

  • Siteefy Newsletter. AI and technology updates for people who build things.

Miscellaneous / Svelte

  • Mr. Jay's Language Learning Tips. A free weekly newsletter with one practical language-learning tip for learners, teachers, and parents, written by an English teacher in Korea.

7. Awesome Pixel Art

Tools / Editors

  • Tessarium - Free with paid upgrade, works on Linux, macOS, Windows and in the browser. Tile-first level editor where editing a tile updates every placement.

8. Awesome for Beginners

JavaScript

  • Posnic (⭐5) (label: good first issue)
    Offline-first open source POS and billing software for retail shops and restaurants, with online/offline workflows.

Java

  • Checkstyle (⭐9.6k) (label: good first issue)
    A development tool to help programmers write Java code that adheres to a coding standard.
  • Hiero SDK Java (⭐264) (label: Good First Issue)
    Java SDK for interacting with the Hiero network.

TypeScript

  • DevShelf (⭐5) (label: good first issue)
    A crowdsourced, zero-paywall directory of developer tools, free APIs, and 1-click boilerplates with continuous uptime monitoring.
  • OffPDF (⭐27) (label: good first issue)
    An open-source, offline-first desktop toolkit for editing, organizing, converting, compressing, securing, and OCRing PDF files locally.

Python

  • mindshub (⭐40k) (label: good first issue)
    MindsDB is an open source AI layer for existing databases.

9. Awesome Go

SQL Query Builders

  • dba (⭐2) - SQL query builder for hand-written SQL, adding dynamic conditions, dialect-aware placeholders, and immutable chaining.

Networking

  • expose (⭐9) - Lightweight, open-source secure tunneling tool to expose local servers to the internet.

10. Awesome Ruby

Compression

  • rubyzip (⭐1.4k) - A Ruby library for reading and writing zip files.

HTML/XML Parsing

  • Loofah (⭐1k) - A general library for manipulating and transforming HTML/XML documents and fragments, built on top of Nokogiri, with built-in HTML sanitizers.

Optimizations

  • Oj (⭐3.2k) - A fast JSON parser and Object marshaller.

PDF

  • typst (⭐42) - Ruby binding to Typst, a markup-based typesetting system, to compile documents to PDF, SVG, PNG or HTML.

Spreadsheets and Documents

  • fast_excel (⭐362) - Ultra fast Excel (xlsx) writer for Ruby, a wrapper for libxlsxwriter using FFI.

11. Awesome Neovim

Scrolling / Scrollbar

  • mihovilrak/scroll.nvim (⭐15) - Draggable scrollbars with support for diagnostics, Git changes and search matches and minimap.

Pre-made Configuration / Stats Tracking

  • JimmyPla6z/FireVim - A lightweight, opinionated Neovim distribution with a single init.lua, built on Neovim 0.12+.

12. Awesome Testing

Software / Security Testing

  • Darkmoon (⭐967) - Open-source (GPLv3) autonomous AI penetration-testing CLI with 50 specialist agents and 140+ offensive tools over MCP for DAST-style web and API security assessment.

Software / Test Data Management

  • JsonFabrica - API-first service for realistic synthetic JSON test data from reusable templates: relational batches with referential integrity, seed-reproducible output, and an MCP server for AI agents.
  • Código ao Ponto - Free browser-based test data generators and validators for Brazilian documents (CPF, CNPJ, RG, CNH) with valid check digits, plus test credit cards. No signup.
  • LaunchStock Test Data Generator - Browser generator for six modelled businesses: retail, SaaS, healthcare, banking, logistics and HR. Values agree across tables, not just across keys. Order totals reconcile against their lines, a bank ledger balances forward, and a discharge never precedes its admission. Exports CSV, JSON or a PostgreSQL dump, no account. A paid pack adds your own schema and unlimited rows.

Software / Performance & Load Testing

  • JMeterHub - Interactive performance report visualizer for Apache JMeter logs with zero setup, AI conclusions, and shareable reports.

13. Awesome Mac

Design and Product / Design Tools

  • Screen Loupe - Open-source live magnifier that shows any part of the screen zoomed, pixel-true, in a separate window.

14. Awesome Raspberry Pi

Tools

  • sbc.compare - Benchmarks, specs and prices for 20+ Raspberry Pi models, from the Zero to the Pi 5 in every RAM size, all tested in-house with the same methodology, with side-by-side comparisons.

entry.content:

JavaScript

  • pixi.js (⭐48k) (label: 🤩 Good First PR)
    A 2D JavaScript Renderer
  • altair (⭐5.4k) (label: good first issue)
    A beautiful feature-rich GraphQL Client for all platforms.
  • Create React App (⭐103k) (label: good first issue)
    Create React apps with no build configuration.
  • Decap CMS (⭐19k) (label: good first issue)
    Open source content management for your git workflow.
  • HueHive (⭐69) (label: good first issue)
    An open source react native app iOS and android for color palette management
  • Jest (⭐45k) (label: good first issue)
    A complete and easy to set up JavaScript testing solution.
  • PouchDB (⭐18k) (label: help-wanted)
    PouchDB is a pocket-sized database.
  • React (⭐251k) (label: good first issue)
    A declarative, efficient, and flexible JavaScript library for building user interfaces.
  • React Native (⭐127k) (label: Good-first-issue)

  • stryker (⭐3.2k) (label: 👶 Good first issue)
    The JavaScript mutation testing framework
  • WarpDrive (⭐3.2k) (label: Good-for-New-Contributors)
    A data persistence library for Ember.js.

C++

  • MoveIt (⭐2.1k) (label: good first issue)
    Easy-to-use open source robotics manipulation platform for developing commercial applications, prototyping designs, and benchmarking algorithms.

Go

  • Dragonfly (⭐3.3k) (label: good first issue)
    Provide efficient, stable and secure file distribution and image acceleration based on p2p technology
  • Helm (⭐30k) (label: good first issue)
    The Kubernetes Package Manager
  • Incus (⭐6.2k) (label: easy)
    System container and virtual machine manager.
  • Meshery (⭐12k) (label: good first issue)
    Meshery, the service mesh management plane.

PHP

  • Flarum (⭐6.8k) (label: Good-first-issue)
    Simple forum software for building great communities.

Python

  • django cookiecutter (⭐14k) (label: hacktoberfest)
    An implementation of Python for backend web development.
  • FastAPI (⭐103k) (label: good first issue)
    A modern, fast (high-performance) web framework for building APIs with Python 3.6+ based on standard Python type hints.

Rust

  • Ockam (⭐4.6k) (label: good first issue)
    End-to-end encryption and mutual authentication for distributed applications.
  • Rustfmt (⭐7k) (label: good first issue)
    A tool for formatting Rust code according to style guidelines.
  • videocall-rs (⭐1.8k) (label: good first issue)
    Teleconference system with a web based user interface written in Rust

TypeScript

  • reatom (⭐1.4k) (label: good first issue)
    Reatom is declarative and reactive state manager, designed for both simple and complex applications.
  • tinyhttp (⭐2.9k) (label: good first issue)
    A 0-legacy, tiny & fast web framework as a replacement of Express.

2. Awesome Bitcoin

Blockchain API and Web services

  • Luganodes RPC - Bitcoin Core JSON-RPC endpoints on dedicated bare-metal infrastructure with a free tier.

3. Awesome Game Remakes

Simulator

  • OpenGG (⭐0) - Open-source engine for Gearhead Garage: The Virtual Mechanic (1999), the car repair game; requires the original game files.

4. Awesome Tmux

Tools and session management

  • muxly Native tmux client for iPhone and iPad, built around tmux control mode for native window tabs, pane navigation, smooth scrolling, and more

5. Awesome Rails

Open Source Rails Apps / Other external resources

  • RexOne (⭐6) - Sovereign full-stack application foundation spanning Rails 8 API, React 19, and Flutter mobile (using Rails 8.1). - 🌍

6. Awesome Cli Apps

Entertainment / Music

  • mpv-music (⭐25) - Daemonless music player.

7. Webcomponents the Right Way

Design Systems

  • Carbon Web Components (⭐295) - Carbon Design System variant on top of Web Components.

8. Awesome Lit

Tools / Building

  • vite-plugin-lit - Vite plugin for Lit adding HMR support, shadow root CSS helpers and a DevTools panel.

9. Awesome Lidar

Libraries

  • lasrs-cpp (⭐0) - C++20 and C library for reading and writing LAS, LAZ and COPC with parallel LAZ decoding, built on the Rust crates las-rs and laz-rs.
    • GitHub repository (⭐0)

10. Awesome Broadcasting

Monitoring & Quality Control

  • StreamPilot (⭐11) - Real-time supervision and geolocation of mobile video transmitters (Haivision SST/StreamHub). GPS tracking, link metrics, Slack notifications and session reporting.

11. Free for Dev

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • Sharry - Screen sharing via the browser, no downloads, no installs. Useful for pair programming, presentations or remote support. Free tier: no account, 5-minute sessions, 1 viewer.

Code Quality

  • tomosu.ai - Scores a repository or pull request with a 0-100 Production Reliability Index, plus fix suggestions and a merge verdict. Free for one repository (public or private) through the VS Code/Cursor plugin, web scan, and GitHub App PR comments.

Crash and Exception Handling

  • Vinktar - Error tracking and product analytics in one tool, set up and queried by your coding agent over MCP. Free for 1M events and 50k errors per month, no card required.

Managed Data Services

  • Neon - Managed Postgres, 0.5 GB of storage per project, 100 projects, 10 branches per project, 100 CU-hours of compute per project per month, autoscaling up to 2 CU, scales to zero after 5 minutes. Includes S3-compatible Object Storage with 5 GB per project that branches with the database. 5 GB of network transfer per project, shared across all products.

12. Awesome Iot

Software / Libraries and Tools

  • mqttkit (⭐4) - Elysia-style application framework for MQTT in TypeScript / Bun. Compose broker adapters, ordered middleware, typed topic routes, MQTT 5 RPC, and AsyncAPI 3.0 docs on top of Aedes or any MQTT broker.

Newsletters / JavaScript on Things: Hardware for Web Developers (2018 - est.) by Lyza Danger Gardner [early access book]

  • TinkerNews - A free weekly newsletter curating noteworthy DIY electronics builds across ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and IoT. Each issue gives a concise introduction to practical projects and links back to the original tutorial, article, or repository so readers can explore the details and build from the source.

13. Awesome Digital History

Archives and primary sources / Switzerland

  • Books as Data - Full-text and metadata corpus of 1700–1900 prints from four Swiss libraries, with bulk export and IIIF images.
  • Swissvotes - Database of Swiss federal popular votes since 1848, including results, contextual information, analyses, original documents, and downloadable data.

14. Awesome K6

Tools

  • k6 Testkube executor

Extensions / Community

  • xk6-sip (⭐8) - Load and call-flow testing of SIP/VoIP systems: scripted subscribers call each other through the PBX, with RTP media and voice quality checks.

15. Awesome Blazor

ToDos

  • StudyLife (⭐1) - Self-hosted study organizer: calendar, exam/study planner, focus timer, notes and a progress dashboard, with a growing family of add-ons (native app, browser extensions, CLI, VS Code, Telegram, Discord, Home Assistant...) built on Blazor WebAssembly + ASP.NET Core. Demo.

16. Awesome Privacy

Analytics

  • Rybbit - Open-source and privacy-friendly alternative to Google Analytics that is 10x more intuitive.

ChatGPT

  • LocalAI (⭐49k) - Self-hosted, community-driven simple local OpenAI-compatible API written in go. Can be used as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI, running on CPU with consumer-grade hardware.
  • ollama (⭐182k) - Get up and running with Llama 2 and other large language models locally.

Image Generation

  • ComfyUI (⭐136k) - ComfyUI lets you execute advanced image generation pipelines using an advanced interface. Available on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Bookmarking

  • 42links - Open-source, self-hosted, minimalist bookmark storage service.
  • Floccus - Sync your bookmarks privately across browsers and devices.
  • Grimoire (⭐2.9k) - Modern, open source, self-hosted bookmark manager.
  • Karakeep - (previously Hoarder) Open source "Bookmark Everything" app that uses AI for automatically tagging the content you throw at it.
  • LinkAce (⭐3.3k) - Open source, self-hosted bookmark archive that monitors and organizes your saved links (GPL-3.0).
  • LinkDing (⭐11k) - Open source, self-hosted bookmark manager built to be minimal, fast, and easy to run with Docker (MIT).
  • Shiori (⭐12k) - Open source, self-hosted bookmark manager written in Go, usable as a CLI or web app (MIT).
  • Wallabag - Open-source, optionally self-hosted, read it later server. Provides paid hosted service with privacy in mind.
  • Linkwarden - Self-hosted bookmark manager that saves and archives full copies of the pages you collect (AGPL-3.0).
  • Readeck - Single-binary self-hosted read-it-later app that saves and archives articles for offline reading (AGPL-3.0).

Commenting Engines

  • Comentario - Tiny, Privacy-focused, Open-source web comment engine, which adds discussion functionality to plain, boring web pages.
  • Disgus (⭐53) - Embeddable comments for your website, backed by Nostr. Like Disqus but Nostr.
  • Isso (⭐5.3k) - A lightweight, self hosted, commenting server written in Python and JavaScript. It aims to be a drop-in replacement for Disqus.
  • Remark42 - Self-hosted, lightweight, and simple (yet functional) comment engine, which doesn't spy on users.
  • Giscus - Commenting system that stores discussions in GitHub Discussions, with no database, ads, or tracking. Open source, MIT licensed.

Screen recording

  • Screenity - A powerful privacy-friendly screen recorder and annotation tool to make better videos for work, education, and more.

Databases

  • Supabase - Open source Firebase alternative (Limited (⭐111k) self-hosting (⭐111k))

Domains & Hosting

  • 1984 Hosting - Iceland-based hosting and domain registrar focused on civil rights, with Monero and anonymous signup.

Ebooks

  • Amazon Kindle - Tracks reading activity, requires an Amazon account, and has a documented history of remote deletion.
  • Google Play Books - Tied to a Google account, tracks reading data, and does not offer an offline-only mode.
  • Kobo / Apple Books - Require accounts and sync reading data to company servers by default.
  • Calibre - Open-source ebook manager for Linux, Windows, and macOS with format conversion, metadata editing, and a built-in reader (GPL-3.0).
  • Kavita (⭐12k) - Cross-platform self-hosted digital library for ebooks and comics with a built-in web reader (GPL-3.0).
  • Komga (⭐6.7k) - Self-hosted media server for comics, magazines, and ebooks with a responsive web interface and OPDS support (MIT).

Forms

  • TypeBot - Open-source conversational forms.

Plugins for Minecraft

  • FreedomChat (⭐234) - A great alternative to No-Chat-Reports, since it does not break any chat plugin by design.

Home Assistants

  • OpenVoiceOS - Open source voice assistant and the maintained successor to Mycroft, running fully offline on your own hardware. Apache-2.0 licensed.
  • Home Assistant - Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.

Decentralized

  • Status - Status is a secure messaging app, crypto wallet, and Web3 browser built with state of the art technology.

Third-Party owned

  • ProtonMail - Secure Email. Based in Switzerland. Read this article over Climate activist arrest.
  • mailbox.org - Paid email, calendar and office suite based in Germany, with built-in PGP encryption and no ads.

Audio

  • Spotube (⭐50k) - A lightweight free Spotify crossplatform-client.

Notes and Tasks

  • AppFlowy - Open Source Notion Alternative. You are in charge of your data and customizations.
  • Standard Notes - A free, open-source, and completely encrypted notes app.
  • Trilium Notes (⭐38k) - Build your personal knowledge base with Trilium Notes

Email verification required, accepting monero

  • Onlinesim - Receive SMS online to virtual phone number. (Based in Russia)

Based on Linux

  • Nura (formerly postmarketOS) - Touch optimised and pre-configured version of Alpine Linux.

GNU/Linux

  • Fedora - Community Linux distribution sponsored by Red Hat, shipping recent open source software on a six-month cycle.
  • Whonix is an operating system that runs inside virtual machines and forces every connection through Tor.
  • Kicksecure is a hardened Debian-based distribution from the Whonix developers, secure by default.
  • secureblue is a hardened image built on Fedora Atomic Desktops, with security-focused defaults and a hardened browser.

Password Managers

  • AliasVault - An open source E2EE password & alias manager with a built-in email alias server

Pastebin and Secret Sharing

  • crypt.fyi - Ephemeral zero-knowledge sensitive data sharing platform with web, cli, and chrome-extension clients

Third-party

  • Ente - End-to-end encrypted storage for photos and videos. Open source, audited independently.

Routers

  • Stock ISP routers and vendor firmware: closed source, slow or missing security updates, and often phone home to the vendor or ISP.
  • OpenWrt - Open source Linux firmware that replaces the stock software on hundreds of consumer routers, with years of security updates.
  • OPNsense - Open source firewall and routing platform based on FreeBSD, for dedicated hardware or a spare PC.
  • IPFire - Hardened open source Linux firewall distribution with intrusion prevention and a web interface.

RSS Readers

  • Feedly
  • Inoreader
  • Google News

YouTube

  • ViewTube (⭐1.5k) - ViewTube is an alternative privacy-friendly YouTube frontend written in Vue.js

Teamworking Tools

  • Stoat (formerly Revolt) - User-first chat platform built with modern web technologies.

Translation

  • TranslateLocally (⭐632) – Free/open-source neural MT, runs offline on your computer

Uncategorized

  • Visited (⭐98) - Locally collect browsing history over browsers.

Version Control

  • Radicle - An open source, peer-to-peer code collaboration stack built on Git. Unlike centralized code hosting platforms, there is no single entity controlling the network. Repositories are replicated across peers in a decentralized manner, and users are in full control of their data and workflow.

VPNs / Alternative clients/modifications of Discord:

  • nadanada (formerly LNVPN) - Pay-per-use WireGuard VPN with no account, paid by Lightning Network or other cryptocurrency.

Desktop / Alternative clients/modifications of Discord:

  • Firefox - Open Source, independent browser. It needs some hardening and tweaking to achieve great privacy.
    • LibreWolf - Privacy-focused Firefox fork.

Anti-tracking / Alternative clients/modifications of Discord:

  • LibRedirect (⭐4.1k) - A simple web extension that redirects Twitter, YouTube, Google Maps and many more requests to privacy friendly alternatives. Former Privacy Redirect is no longer maintained, LibRedirect is a maintained fork.

Whistleblowing / Alternative clients/modifications of Discord:

  • GlobaLeaks - Self-hostable whistleblowing platform for organisations, newsrooms and activists, replacing hosted reporting portals. Open source (AGPL-3.0).
  • SecureDrop - Self-hosted submission system that lets newsrooms receive documents from anonymous sources over Tor, replacing email and cloud uploads. Open source (AGPL-3.0).

17. Awesome Rust

Development tools / Testing

  • Code Coverage
    • minikin/cargo-crap (⭐408) [cargo-crap] - Finds complex, untested functions by combining cyclomatic complexity with LCOV coverage (the CRAP metric) and gates CI on the score
    • supercorp-ai/supercov (⭐59) [supercov] - Code quality and test coverage for coding agents: Jev scores each source file so the agent knows what to fix first
    • tarpaulin - A code coverage tool

Libraries / Finance

  • rust-dd/stochastic-rs (⭐188) [stochastic-rs] - Quantitative finance: 130+ stochastic processes, option pricing and calibration, volatility surfaces and copulas, SIMD/GPU accelerated with Python bindings.

18. Awesome Datascience

Tools

  • YYLO Benchmark (⭐1) - Open-source trusted-host experiment runner for historical agent tasks, supplied coding prompts, and workflows. Runs independent attempts with retained outputs, and compares models, harnesses, and configurations with different checks or judges later. MIT licensed.
  • YYLO (⭐60) - Open-source command-line orchestrator for coding agents and repeatable workflows, with typed task, validation, merge, and release-readiness boundaries and receipt-backed repository changes. MIT licensed, installable via npm.

Other Awesome Lists / Book Deals (Affiliated)

  • Awesome Python Math Packages (⭐17) - A curated list of Python packages for mathematics, from linear algebra and optimization to statistics and topology.

19. Awesome Mac

Browsers / Audio Record and Process

  • Yalqen - Open-source, Chromium-based developer browser with vertical tabs and a keyboard-first command bar.
